description: This file defines a background worker class 'LockWorker' which schedules lock/hide actions on apps via WorkManager in an Android app. It performs repository operations to toggle app lock/hide states based on input parameters.

classes.name: LockWorker
classes.description: A Worker class extending CoroutineWorker to perform lock and hide actions on apps at scheduled times.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the scheduled lock/hide operation based on input data; returns success or failure result.
